segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so I pulled up the quote for 38 seats, with 24 standard users and 14 technician users. Annual comes to $46,800 before tax, and that includes the calibration workflow module and the asset import.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I had. On the asset import, we’re starting with about 6,200 gauges and meters. Is that still covered, or does that push us into services?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It’s covered as long as the data is in the template by May 10. If the team wants us to clean up duplicates or normalize locations, that would be services, but a straight import is included.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Our operations lead said they can get the template done by May 8. We’re trying to go live June 3, because the next audit cycle starts that week.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: June 3 is workable. We’d schedule kickoff the week of May 13, do admin training May 21, technician training May 28, and then keep the first week of June open for support.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That sounds reasonable. One thing on billing: finance asked if the invoice can be split 50 percent at signature and 50 percent on July 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, I checked with deal desk. We can do 50 percent due on signature and 50 percent due July 1, net 30 on both. I’ll add that to the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Thanks. And the term is 12 months, right? We’re not ready for a three-year right now.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 12-month initial term, auto-renewal for one-year periods unless either side gives 30 days’ notice. No price increase in the first renewal over 5 percent.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send the updated order form and I’ll route it today. If legal doesn’t have comments, we should be able to sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send it in the next hour with the implementation dates listed in the notes, and I’ll include the security packet again so they don’t have to dig for it.
